name: Email OTP Login
description: Passwordless login via a 6-digit code emailed to the user. SECURITY: the login/verify endpoints are public (access content) and verification has NO rate-limiting, NO attempt limit, NO invalidation on failed guesses, and NO OTP expiry (the code is stored raw in State) — so an anonymous attacker can brute-force any account's 6-digit OTP and take it over. Do NOT use until it enforces attempt-limiting + expiry.
